newsitem.title: SAUDI ARABIA: Saudi lawyer meets kin of jailed British nurses.
newsitem.headline: Saudi lawyer meets kin of jailed British nurses.

text.p: A lawyer for two British nurses charged with murder in Saudi Arabia said on Saturday he met their relatives and discussed legal strategy.

Saudi lawyer Salah al-Hejailan's firm said in a statement faxed to Reuters that the families of the two nurses -- Deborah Parry, 41, and Lucille McLauchlan, 31 -- would travel to Dammam to visit them in the coming days.
Parry and McLauchlan have been charged with the murder of Australian nurse Yvonne Gilford, 55, at a hospital complex in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province in December.
They could face public beheading by the sword if convicted.
Relatives of the two nurses visited them in Dammam prison in January.
Saudi police said the nurses confessed to the murder and the confession had been filed with three judges.
But Hejailan's law firm said they had withdrawn their confessions, and one of them retraced a statement that she had a lesbian relationship with the victim.
